metadata.description: Stack-first skills library covering QA, frontend, backend, data, and business-analysis: install one self-contained plugin per tech stack. `qa-{java,dotnet,typescript}` bundle every QA discipline — API/UI/mobile/performance/LLM/BDD authoring and verification, manual-QA process, CI/CD, reporting, and OWASP-mapped security. `fe-{blazor,react}` are phased frontend dev-stack agents (scaffold → architecture → features → quality → tests → review). `be-{dotnet,java,node}` are phased backend dev-stack agents for design-pattern application, ORM persistence, and Auth0/Cognito service-side auth. `devops` ships the platform lane — container images, IaC, cloud deploys, and build/deploy pipelines. `data` and `business-analysis` round out the database-engineering and cross-feature requirements domains.

plugins.name: qa-java
plugins.description: Self-contained senior automation-QA plugin for Java 21 (RestAssured + TestNG, Selenium/Playwright/Appium, Gatling, Cucumber-JVM). Covers every discipline end-to-end: API/UI/mobile/performance/LLM test authoring and review, BDD living documentation, deep verification (DB, messaging, email, files, websockets), Pact contracts, chaos and feature-flag testing. Bundles the language-agnostic manual-QA process skills, CI/CD pipeline skills, test reporting (Allure + flaky-test quarantine), and the cross-stack OWASP-mapped security skills and qa-security agent — install just this one plugin for a complete Java QA toolkit.

plugins.name: qa-dotnet
plugins.description: Self-contained senior automation-QA plugin for .NET 10 / C#, 8-9 supported and version-aware (NUnit + RestSharp, Playwright/Selenium/Appium, NBomber, Reqnroll). Covers every discipline end-to-end: project scaffolding from zero (API/UI/mobile/performance/BDD), API/UI/mobile/performance/LLM test authoring and review, BDD living documentation, deep verification (DB, messaging, email, files, websockets), Pact contracts, chaos and feature-flag testing, mutation testing (Stryker.NET). Bundles the language-agnostic manual-QA process skills, CI/CD pipeline skills, test reporting (Allure + flaky-test quarantine), and the cross-stack OWASP-mapped security skills and qa-security agent, plus a one-call read-only conformance audit (/qa-dotnet-audit) that sweeps an existing test suite against every convention above into a saved, re-runnable findings report — install just this one plugin for a complete .NET QA toolkit.

plugins.name: qa-typescript
plugins.description: Self-contained senior automation-QA plugin for TypeScript (Vitest + fetch + Zod, Playwright/Appium, k6, playwright-bdd / CucumberJS). Covers every discipline end-to-end: API/UI/mobile/performance/LLM test authoring and review, BDD living documentation, deep verification (DB, messaging, email, files, websockets), Pact contracts, chaos and feature-flag testing. Bundles the language-agnostic manual-QA process skills, CI/CD pipeline skills, test reporting (Allure + flaky-test quarantine), and the cross-stack OWASP-mapped security skills and qa-security agent — install just this one plugin for a complete TypeScript QA toolkit.

plugins.name: fe-blazor
plugins.description: Self-contained senior frontend Blazor developer plugin for .NET 8/9/10 (Blazor Web App, unified render modes). Covers the full FE build lifecycle end-to-end: project scaffold and render-mode strategy, architecture foundations (state, component library, styling, responsive design), feature build (pages/components/forms, API + live/realtime data, motion, UX writing, data-testids), quality layers (accessibility, performance, error resilience, SEO), and bUnit v2 component tests — plus a distinctive-visual-design critique loop. Bundles the Auth0 Blazor auth skills and the stack-agnostic design-craft skills (frontend-design, design-tokens, dataviz, brand-intake, iconography, ux-heuristics, theme-factory, ux-writing, web-design-guidelines) and the phased fe-blazor orchestrator agent — install just this one plugin for a complete Blazor frontend toolkit.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: Self-contained senior data / database engineer plugin across 8 engines — PostgreSQL, SQL Server / Azure SQL, MySQL / MariaDB / Aurora, MongoDB, Redis / Valkey, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch. Covers the full data lifecycle end-to-end: engine selection and version detection, schema / document / container modeling, security (roles / RLS / encryption / fine-grained IAM / DLS-FLS / audit), safe expand-contract online migrations, indexing, and query tuning — from a .NET 10 / Java 21 / Node 24 backend. Each engine skill is version-aware; the four cross-engine _shared skills (schema-design, migrations, caching-patterns, query-optimization) own the cross-engine decisions while the engine skills own the mechanics. Bundles the phased data-architect orchestrator agent — install just this one plugin for a complete database-engineering toolkit.

plugins.name: business-analysis
plugins.description: Self-contained senior business-analysis plugin covering the whole upstream requirements lifecycle in two lanes. The AUTHORING lane turns a vague stakeholder ask into refinement-ready artifacts: a single-initiative scoping writeup, outcome-shaped epics, INVEST user stories with Gherkin acceptance criteria, and a review-only backlog readiness audit for stories authored elsewhere. The REASONING lane checks features against the WHOLE project: a persistent per-project business-model knowledge base (docs/business-model/ — read-first / update-after, stable IDs, source traceability), BPMN-disciplined Mermaid flow mapping, one state × event lifecycle grid per business entity with all features overlaid, merged DMN-style decision tables with declared hit policies and mechanical completeness/overlap checks, and the taxonomy-driven feature-conflict sweep (11 conflict classes, mandatory boundary conditions, severity-tabled findings, resolutions recorded as business decisions). Sits upstream of QA test design — its artifacts and boundary conditions are first-class test-basis inputs. Bundles two phased orchestrator agents: requirements-author (scope → epics → stories → audit) and business-analyst (analyze / model / audit modes) — install just this one plugin for a complete business-analysis toolkit.

plugins.name: fe-react
plugins.description: Self-contained senior frontend React developer plugin for React 19/18 + TypeScript (Next.js App Router / RSC primary, Vite SPA fallback; MUI default). Covers the full FE build lifecycle end-to-end: project scaffold and rendering-strategy choice, architecture foundations (RSC/'use client' boundary, App Router route topology, state, component library, styling, responsive design), feature build (pages/components/forms with React Hook Form + Zod, API + live/realtime data via RSC fetch/Server Actions/TanStack Query/SSE/WebSocket, motion, UX writing, data-testids), quality layers (accessibility, performance, error resilience, SEO, i18n, PWA/offline), and Vitest + React Testing Library component tests — plus version migration (React 18→19, Next 14→15, Pages→App Router), a distinctive-visual-design critique loop, and a one-call read-only conformance audit (/fe-react-audit) that sweeps an existing codebase against every convention above into a saved, re-runnable findings report. Bundles the Auth0 React auth skills and the stack-agnostic design-craft skills (frontend-design, design-tokens, dataviz, brand-intake, iconography, ux-heuristics, theme-factory, ux-writing, web-design-guidelines) and the phased fe-react orchestrator agent — install just this one plugin for a complete React frontend toolkit.

plugins.name: be-dotnet
plugins.description: Self-contained senior .NET backend developer plugin (.NET 10 primary, 8/9 supported) for design-pattern application, EF Core persistence, and Auth0/Cognito service-side auth. Covers explaining patterns (Strategy, Decorator, Repository, CQRS/MediatR, Factory, Specification, Options, Pipeline, Saga, Outbox), scaffolding them into a codebase with constructor injection / async-all-the-way / nullable reference types, EF Core persistence (DbContext design, configurations, migrations, query patterns, optimistic concurrency, bulk operations), Auth0/Cognito JWT bearer validation + RBAC + Client Credentials M2M, and reviewing existing code for pattern misuse, DI/async violations, and layering bleeds — end-to-end or any single phase. Bundles the language-agnostic pattern reference/reviewer, the Auth0/Cognito concepts skills, the developer-workflow + read-only audit (ep-*) skills and the code-auditor agent, and the full observability toolkit (OpenTelemetry + Serilog structured logging + Loki/Tempo/Prometheus-Mimir backend + LogQL/PromQL + Grafana dashboards), plus the phased be-dotnet orchestrator and observability-engineer-dotnet agents and a one-call read-only conformance audit (/be-dotnet-audit) that sweeps an existing service against every convention above into a saved, re-runnable findings report — install just this one plugin for a complete .NET backend toolkit.

plugins.name: be-java
plugins.description: Self-contained senior Java backend developer plugin (Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.x) for design-pattern application, JPA/Hibernate persistence, and Auth0/Cognito service-side auth. Covers explaining patterns (Strategy, Decorator, Repository, CQRS/mediator, Factory, Specification, Options/`@ConfigurationProperties`, Pipeline, Saga, Outbox), scaffolding them into a codebase with constructor injection / virtual-threads-async / modern-Java idioms (records, sealed types), JPA/Hibernate + Spring Data persistence (entity design, Flyway migrations, `@Transactional` boundaries, `@Version` optimistic locking, N+1 prevention), Auth0/Cognito Spring Security resource server + method-level RBAC + Client Credentials M2M, and reviewing existing code for pattern misuse, threading/DI violations, and layering bleeds — end-to-end or any single phase. Bundles the language-agnostic pattern reference/reviewer, the Auth0/Cognito concepts skills, the developer-workflow + read-only audit (ep-*) skills and the code-auditor agent, and the full observability toolkit (OpenTelemetry Java agent + SLF4J/Logback structured logging + Loki/Tempo/Prometheus-Mimir backend + LogQL/PromQL + Grafana dashboards), plus the phased be-java orchestrator and observability-engineer-java agents — install just this one plugin for a complete Java backend toolkit.

plugins.name: be-node
plugins.description: Self-contained senior Node backend developer plugin (Node 24 active LTS primary, 22 maintenance supported; TypeScript strict) for design-pattern application and Prisma/Drizzle persistence. Covers explaining patterns (discriminated-union strategy, `Result<T,E>` vs throwing, branded ids, higher-order-function decorators, repository, lightweight CQRS command handlers, Options config via Zod), scaffolding them into a Node/NestJS/Express codebase with constructor injection or closures / async-all-the-way / TypeScript strict mode, Prisma (default) / Drizzle / TypeORM persistence (schema design, migrations, query patterns, optimistic concurrency, bulk operations), and reviewing existing code for type-safety leaks, pattern misuse, and async/DI violations — end-to-end or any single phase. Bundles the language-agnostic pattern reference/reviewer, the developer-workflow + read-only audit (ep-*) skills and the code-auditor agent, and the full observability toolkit (OpenTelemetry sdk-node + pino structured logging + Loki/Tempo/Prometheus-Mimir backend + LogQL/PromQL + Grafana dashboards), plus the phased be-node orchestrator and observability-engineer-node agents — install just this one plugin for a complete Node backend-patterns toolkit.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Self-contained senior DevOps / platform engineer plugin — the path from a built service to a running one: production-shaped container images (multi-stage, pinned, non-root, healthchecked), Infrastructure as Code (Bicep for Azure, Terraform for AWS/multi-cloud), cloud deploy primitives (AWS ECS Fargate / Lambda / App Runner / S3+CloudFront / EKS and Azure Container Apps / Functions / App Service / Static Web Apps / AKS), Kubernetes manifests and Helm/Kustomize, build-and-deploy pipelines on GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Azure Pipelines, and per-environment configuration and secrets. Cloud-keyed rather than stack-triplicated, and version-aware across .NET 10 (8/9 supported) / Java 21 / Node 24 (22 maintenance). OIDC and Workload Identity Federation throughout — no static cloud credentials anywhere. Bundles the phased devops-engineer orchestrator agent plus the ep-* developer-workflow skills and the code-auditor agent — install just this one plugin for a complete deploy toolkit.
